title: Oasis Sweet & Sips - A Selection of Moroccan Themed Pastries and Cookies - EPCOT | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Oasis Sweets & Sips Located in World Showcase at EPCOT Delight in delectable treats like Pistachio Baklava and Almond Crescent Cookies, as well as exotic drinks—Frozen Cocktails, Sangria and more. Non-Alcoholic Beverages are also available.View Menu American Bakery Mediterranean Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM Valid admission required.
